create_OptimWrapperDict: create an OptimWrapperDict instance with multiple named OptimWrapper optimizers for multi-optimizer training
zero_grad_OptimWrapperDict: call zero_grad on an OptimWrapperDict to zero gradients across all contained optimizer wrappers
get_lr_OptimWrapperDict: get the learning rates of all optimizers in an OptimWrapperDict as a nested dictionary
state_dict_OptimWrapperDict: get or load the state dictionary of all optimizer wrappers in an OptimWrapperDict for checkpointing
access_OptimWrapper_by_key: access a specific OptimWrapper from an OptimWrapperDict by its key name using bracket notation
